## Foundation-First Rule

Before implementing a feature, determine whether the feature
could be reused by another Bible story.

If it can be reused, prefer implementing it as a foundation
capability.

Example:

"Create a quiz about Noah"
→ Noah story requirement.

"Create a reusable quiz engine"
→ Foundation requirement.

"Shuffle quiz answers"
→ Foundation capability.

"Noah quiz questions"
→ Noah story content.
